title: Business Calculus with Excel
description: This text is intended for a one semester calculus course for business students with the equivalent of a college algebra prerequisite. Rather than being a three-semester engineering calculus course that has been watered down to fit into one semester it is designed for the business students.
publisher: Mike May, S.J. and Anneke Bart
